evidence: Changing Windows projection modes resets Power Display per-monitor visibility settings. A later current-main change preserves recently disconnected monitor entries.
Reporter provides a six-step sequence: hide all but brightness, switch Extend to PC screen only, restart or close, restore Extend, refresh displays; preferences reset to defaults.
PR #47712 merged on 2026-05-08, after the report, and current MonitorSettingsRebuilder preserves missing non-hidden monitor entries for 30 days with unit coverage.
Confirmed PR #47712 is merged after the issue report; it is not evidence that the fix shipped in a released build.
